03 / THE DESIGN PRINCIPLES

Let the light in.

Use porcelain for service information and longer reading. Keep graphite for immersive photography and decisive moments.

Make metal matter.

Reserve brushed finishes for signage, print, and physical objects. Keep everyday digital marks simple and flat.

Give it space.

Wide margins, deliberate typography, and a fine horizontal line create a confident rhythm across every application.
